# Session Archive System
# Archives complete session history before daily cleanup

$ArchiveRoot = "C:\Users\Karen\.openclaw\workspace\memory\session-archive"
$SessionFile = "C:\Users\Karen\.openclaw\sessions.json"
$Date = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd"
$Year = Get-Date -Format "yyyy"
$MonthName = Get-Date -Format "MM-MMMM"

# Create directory structure
$ArchiveDir = Join-Path $ArchiveRoot "$Year\$MonthName\$Date"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ArchiveDir -Force | Out-Null

Write-Host "Archiving sessions for $Date to $ArchiveDir"

# Copy raw session data
if (Test-Path $SessionFile) {
    $TargetFile = Join-Path $ArchiveDir "sessions.json"
    Copy-Item $SessionFile $TargetFile -Force
    $sessionSize = (Get-Item $SessionFile).Length
    Write-Host "  sessions.json ($([math]::Round($sessionSize/1KB, 2)) KB)"
} else {
    Write-Host "  No sessions.json found"
}

# Create human-readable summary
$summaryFile = Join-Path $ArchiveDir "conversations.md"
$timestamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"
$header = "# Conversation Archive - $Date`n`n**Generated:** $timestamp`n**System:** OpenClaw on DESKTOP-M8AO8LN`n`n## Sessions Summary`n`n"
$header | Out-File $summaryFile -Encoding UTF8

# Extract conversation topics if sessions exist
if (Test-Path $SessionFile) {
    try {
        $sessions = Get-Content $SessionFile | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        foreach ($session in $sessions) {
            $sessionTime = if ($session.created_at) { 
                [datetime]::Parse($session.created_at).ToString("HH:mm") 
            } else { "unknown" }
            $shortId = if ($session.id) { $session.id.Substring(0,[Math]::Min(8, $session.id.Length)) } else { "unknown" }
            "- **$sessionTime** - Session $shortId...`n" | Add-Content $summaryFile
        }
    } catch {
        "- Raw session data archived (parse error)`n" | Add-Content $summaryFile
    }
}

"`n---`n*Full session data available in sessions.json*" | Add-Content $summaryFile
Write-Host "  conversations.md created"

# Create search index
$indexFile = Join-Path $ArchiveDir "search-index.json"
$isoTime = Get-Date -Format "o"
$index = @{
    date = $Date
    timestamp = $isoTime
    topics = @()
    projects = @()
    files_modified = @()
    keywords = @()
}
$index | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3 | Out-File $indexFile -Encoding UTF8
Write-Host "  search-index.json created"

# Calculate totals
$archiveSize = (Get-ChildItem $ArchiveDir -Recurse -File | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum
Write-Host "Archive complete: $([math]::Round($archiveSize/1KB, 2)) KB"

# Show storage summary
$totalUsed = (Get-ChildItem $ArchiveRoot -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum
$totalGB = [math]::Round($totalUsed / 1GB, 3)
Write-Host "Total archive usage: $totalGB GB / ~1000 GB available"
